subject: CFA Error when running fitmeasures in lavaan

messages.author: 1492594a58399e6c
messages.subject: CFA Error when running fitmeasures in lavaan
parts:
I have run the following code

ModelBRc <- 'BRc =~ BR11 + BR12'
fitBRc <- cfa(ModelBRc, data=imputeFM, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(fitBRc, rsq=TRUE,fit.measures=TRUE)
fitmeasures(fitBRc)
varTable(fitBRc)

and I get this warning

Warning messages:
1: In qchisq(p = 0.95, df = df) : NaNs produced

my summary fit measures show all NA and fit measures produces NaNs

Can anyone help how to rectify this?

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: CFA Error when running fitmeasures in lavaan
parts:
That's a tiny model, which (I think) -1 df.

That's not the only model. When you run the model you should get a warning that the model is not identified.

When you look at the summary you should see that there are no fit indices and no standard errors.

You can't run a CFA with 2 variables - if you could, it wouldn't tell you anything, you need a minimum of 3 variables to identify the model, and 4 to make it meaningful.

Jeremy
